title: aspleniopsis decipiens

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, where it is believed to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aspleniopsis decipiens are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
